name: Open Culture
summary: Editorial guide to free cultural and educational media: online courses, audiobooks, movies, textbooks and podcasts.
description: A regularly updated blog that catalogues free cultural and educational media: curated guides to free online courses, audiobooks, eBooks, textbooks, movies, podcasts, language lessons and K-12 resources. Posts are written by editors, tagged by subject (art, books, history, film, law, data, MIT …) and browsable through category archives; everything it points to is free to access.
